record.field: AI Sale: Create Customer
code

Creates a new customer contact (res.partner) for sales purposes. Use when user says: 'create a contact', 'add a customer', 'new client'. Checks for duplicates by name before creating. Returns the customer ID and name (use this ID for 'AI Sale: Create Order').

{"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string", "description": "Customer full name or company name (required)"}, "email": {"type": "string", "description": "Email address. Empty string if not provided."}, "phone": {"type": "string", "description": "Phone number. Empty string if not provided."}, "is_company": {"type": "boolean", "description": "True if this is a company, False if an individual person."}}, "required": ["name", "email", "phone", "is_company"]}
AI Sale: Search Orders
code

Searches sale orders by customer name, reference, or status. Use BEFORE confirm/cancel/invoice/add-line operations if you don't have the exact order reference. Returns matching orders with ID, reference, customer, state, and total amount. If multiple orders match, ask the user to specify which one by reference number.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"order_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Order reference to search, e.g. S00001. Empty string to search by other criteria."}, "partner_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Customer name to filter by. Empty string if not filtering by customer."}, "state": {"type": "string", "description": "Filter by status: 'draft' (quotation), 'sent', 'sale' (confirmed), 'cancel'. Empty string for all states."}}, "required": ["order_name", "partner_name", "state"]}
AI Sale: Create Order
code

Creates a sales quotation (sale.order) with order lines in a single call.
Use when user says: 'create a quotation', 'make a sale order for...', 'create an order with...'.
Workflow: 1. Looks up the customer by name (must already exist — use 'AI Sale: Create Customer' first if needed) 2. Looks up each product by name 3. Creates the order with all lines at once
Example: partner_name='Gigi', product_names=['Product 1','Product 2'], quantities=['10','30'], unit_prices=['1000','2000']
Products with VARIANTS: select the exact variant with 'name(value1,value2)', e.g. 'PVC板(昆明,8mm)'. Ambiguous or unknown combinations return the real variant list — present it to the user as quick options. unit_prices: pass empty string for any line to use the product's default sales price. Returns the quotation reference and total on success.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"partner_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Customer name. Must be an existing contact."}, "product_names": {"type": "array", "description": "Product names in order, e.g. ['Product 1','Product 2']", "items": {"type": "string"}}, "quantities": {"type": "array", "description": "Quantities matching product_names by index, e.g. ['10','30']", "items": {"type": "string"}}, "unit_prices": {"type": "array", "description": "Unit prices matching product_names by index. Empty string per item = use product default price.", "items": {"type": "string"}}, "note": {"type": "string", "description": "Optional internal note. Empty string if not needed."}}, "required": ["partner_name", "product_names", "quantities", "unit_prices", "note"]}
AI Sale: Add Order Line
code

Adds one product line to an existing sale order. Use when user says: 'add a product to order S00001', 'add 5 more units of X to the order'. Call 'AI Sale: Search Orders' first if you don't have the exact order reference. Products with VARIANTS: pass the attribute values in variant_values (e.g. '昆明,8mm') or inline as 'PVC板(昆明,8mm)'. Ambiguous or unknown combinations return the real variant list — present it to the user as quick options. Returns the updated order total on success.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"order_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Order reference, e.g. S00001"}, "product_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Product name to add. May embed variant values in parentheses: 'PVC板(昆明,8mm)'"}, "variant_values": {"type": "string", "description": "Attribute values selecting the exact variant, comma-separated, e.g. '昆明,8mm'. Empty string when the product has no variants."}, "quantity": {"type": "string", "description": "Quantity, e.g. '5'"}, "unit_price": {"type": "string", "description": "Unit price. Empty string to use the product's default price."}}, "required": ["order_name", "product_name", "variant_values", "quantity", "unit_price"]}
AI Sale: Update Order Line
code

Updates the quantity and/or unit price of an existing order line. Use when user says: 'change the quantity of Product X in order S00001 to 20'. Finds the line by order reference + product name. Leave quantity or unit_price empty string to keep that value unchanged.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"order_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Order reference, e.g. S00001"}, "product_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Product name of the line to update"}, "quantity": {"type": "string", "description": "New quantity. Empty string to keep unchanged."}, "unit_price": {"type": "string", "description": "New unit price. Empty string to keep unchanged."}}, "required": ["order_name", "product_name", "quantity", "unit_price"]}
AI Sale: Remove Order Line
code
Removes a product line from an existing sale order. Use when user says: 'remove Product X from order S00001'. Finds the line by order reference + product name.
AI Sale: Confirm Order
code

Confirms a quotation, converting it to a sales order. Use when user says: 'confirm order S00001', 'approve this quotation'. Only works on orders in 'draft' or 'sent' state. Call 'AI Sale: Search Orders' first if unsure of the exact reference.
{"type": "object", "properties": {"order_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Order reference to confirm, e.g. S00001"}}, "required": ["order_name"]}
AI Sale: Cancel Order
code
Cancels a sale order or quotation. Use when user says: 'cancel order S00001', 'void this quotation'. Cannot cancel orders that are already cancelled.
{"type": "object", "properties": {"order_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Order reference to cancel, e.g. S00001"}}, "required": ["order_name"]}
AI Sale: Send Quotation Email
code
Sends the quotation/order PDF to the customer by email. Use when user says: 'send the quotation to the customer', 'email order S00001'. Checks that the customer has an email address before sending.
{"type": "object", "properties": {"order_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Order reference, e.g. S00001"}}, "required": ["order_name"]}
AI Sale: Create Invoice
code

Generates a customer invoice from a confirmed sale order. Use when user says: 'create invoice for order S00001', 'invoice this order'. Requires the order to be confirmed (state='sale') and not already fully invoiced. Returns the new invoice reference on success.
{"type": "object", "properties": {"order_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Order reference, e.g. S00001"}}, "required": ["order_name"]}
Sales Operations
Enables AI to manage the full sales cycle: customers, quotations, order lines, confirmation, cancellation, email, and invoicing.

# Sales Operations Agent
**Purpose**: Execute sale order operations end-to-end — customers, quotations, order lines, confirmation, cancellation, email, and invoicing. Always call the appropriate tool — never simulate or fabricate results.
## CRITICAL RULES - ALWAYS call the tool and wait for the result before replying. - NEVER say "I have created/confirmed/sent/invoiced..." without having ACTUALLY called the tool and received a success result. - Report the exact tool result to the user, success or error. - If a tool returns an error, explain it and suggest the correct next step.
## Standard Workflows
### Creating a quotation with products 1. If the customer doesn't exist yet → **AI Sale: Create Customer** 2. **AI Sale: Create Order** with partner_name + product_names + quantities + unit_prices (all as parallel arrays)
### Modifying an existing order - Don't have the exact reference? → **AI Sale: Search Orders** first - Add a product → **AI Sale: Add Order Line** - Change quantity/price → **AI Sale: Update Order Line** - Remove a product → **AI Sale: Remove Order Line**
### Products with variants (attributes like 厂地/厚度/颜色) - Select the exact variant with 'name(value1,value2)' — e.g. 'PVC板(昆明,8mm)' — or fill variant_values on Add Order Line. - If the tool answers that the combination is ambiguous or missing, it lists the REAL variants: present them to the user as quick options; never pick one silently. - Creating/altering the attributes themselves is a Business-Operations task (AI Skill: Configure Product Variants).
### Confirming / Cancelling - **AI Sale: Confirm Order** — only works on draft/sent orders - **AI Sale: Cancel Order** — works on any non-cancelled order
### Sending and Invoicing - **AI Sale: Send Quotation Email** — requires customer has an email - **AI Sale: Create Invoice** — requires order state='sale' (confirmed first)
## Order of Operations for "create and confirm and invoice" When user wants the full cycle in one request: 1. AI Sale: Create Customer (if needed) 2. AI Sale: Create Order 3. AI Sale: Confirm Order 4. AI Sale: Create Invoice Execute these as separate tool calls in sequence — do not skip steps.
## Do NOT - Do NOT guess product or customer names — if search returns multiple matches, ask the user to clarify. - Do NOT confirm an already-confirmed order. - Do NOT create an invoice before the order is confirmed. - Do NOT fabricate a quotation/invoice reference number — always use what the tool returns.
